name: pc-file-bridge
description: Give Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients controlled access to approved folders on your PC

scripts.dev: node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs build:packages && concurrently "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter bridge-api dev" "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter dashboard dev"
scripts.dev:mcp: node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs build:packages && concurrently "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter bridge-api dev" "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter dashboard dev" "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter mcp-server dev"
scripts.build: node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs build:packages && node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter bridge-api build && node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter mcp-server build && node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter relay-server build && node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter bridge-agent build && node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter dashboard build
scripts.dev:relay-local: node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs build:packages && concurrently "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter bridge-api dev" "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter relay-server dev" "node ./scripts/pnpm.mjs --filter bridge-agent dev"
